description: Sorts and ranks the pharmacy price offers returned for a medication, ZIP, and quantity, and retrieves or issues the session’s reusable savings card. Returns the top-ranked and backup offers from that price list. Does not purchase medication or send a message.

card_session_id.description: Private UUID for this conversation. Reuse the returned cardSessionId or the UUID already used. For a new conversation with no prior issuance attempt, generate one UUID internally before the first price or card call. Never ask the customer for it or replace it after uncertain issuance.

dosage_form.description: Desired dosage form, e.g. "tablet" — optional disambiguator

drug.description: Medication explicitly requested in the current user turn; never infer from memory

existing_card_reference.description: Existing ClixRx card or coupon share reference, when available. Reuse the existing card instead of issuing another; never invent a reference.

formulation.description: Which product to price when both exist for the same strength and form. Omit to price the generic (what most prescriptions allow). Pass 'brand' only when the customer says their prescription is brand-only or dispense as written, or explicitly asks for the brand price. Never ask the customer to look this up; the pharmacist fills what the prescription allows.

mode.description: Ranking priority: cheapest, best-fit, need-it-tonight, or stay-at-current-pharmacy

quantity.description: Exact dispensed quantity, positive and at most 360 (fractions allowed); ask when absent and never assume 30

strength.description: Desired strength, e.g. "10 mg" — required to disambiguate when a drug has multiple strengths

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP explicitly supplied by the user in this conversation; ask when absent

name: get_recommendation
